report_programme.goal: The owner's full feasibility report comparable to the 88-page sample (property facts, applicable zoning, development options, floors, simple building shapes, legal unit limits, realistic apartment estimates, option comparison, downloadable PDF), with reliable numbers; legal limits kept apart from estimates; no detailed apartment layouts or permit-ready plans (owner 2026-10-06, D-090 R248-R265; CLAUDE.md owner guidance). A finished piece is a milestone, not completion.
report_programme.state_vocabulary: done (accepted), in_progress (claimed: being built or in review), ready (contracted, not started), planned (named task, not yet contracted), not_planned (no task), owner_decision (waits on an owner answer or a decision not yet asked)
